preRestore.name: Temporary stop service before copying configs

postRestore.name: Restore Permissions
postRestore.command: chown postfix:postfix /etc/sasldb2; chmod 660 /etc/sasldb2; sudo gpasswd -a postfix opendkim; sudo chown -R opendkim:opendkim /etc/opendkim

postRestore.name: Restore sasl
postRestore.command: sudo mkdir -p /var/spool/postfix/etc; sudo cp /etc/sasldb2 /var/spool/postfix/etc/sasldb2; sudo chown postfix:postfix /var/spool/postfix/etc/sasldb2; sudo chmod 660 /var/spool/postfix/etc/sasldb2

postRestore.name: Restore Service
postRestore.command: systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl start postfix opendkim; systemctl enable --now postfix opendkim
